text:
elaine: :rotating_light: quick alert — staging RBAC change appears to have granted a non-admin svcacc decrypt against our onprem KMS proxy (cust-kms-01). starting triage now, tagging infra & security.

raj: paste the audit entry and the rolebinding diff pls — which role was modified?

elaine: copying the minimal audit lines we have (sanitized):
```
time=2026-03-20T14:12:03Z principal=svcacc-deploy-runner@redwood infra action=kms.decrypt key=cust-kms-01/resource/edge-123 result=SUCCESS method=kms-proxy-v1 source_ip=10.8.3.22 namespace=staging
time=2026-03-20T14:12:01Z user=alex.pr merged_pr=infra/rolebinding-add-kms-decrypt clusterrole=kms-decryptor target=svcacc-deploy-runner@redwood
```

jordan: that principal should never have decrypt rights. running `kubectl get clusterrolebindings | grep kms-decryptor` and checking history now.

audit-bot: Audit query: https://audit.redwood.internal/q?query=kms.decrypt+cust-kms-01 (found 7 hits in last 24h)

sophia: immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) revoke the service account tokens for svcacc-deploy-runner, 2) apply a network policy to block egress to the KMS proxy from staging pods, 3) consider rotating the affected key or performing an HSM rewrap if any plaintext keys were exposed.

maria: confirm scope — was this strictly staging or did the binding land in prod too? we need blast radius.

elaine: looks limited to staging namespaces so far (audit shows namespace=staging). no prod decrypts yet.

kevin: for IR runbook — recommended order:
- revoke SA tokens and rotate their secrets
- revert the rolebinding change (roll back the PR)
- block KMS egress to untrusted namespaces via netpol and firewall rules
- rotate key material/wrap if there's plausible risk
- extend audit retention and add higher-severity alerting for KMS decrypts by non-admin principals

raj: running commands now — output snippets:
```
# rolebinding diff
- apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
  kind: ClusterRoleBinding
  metadata:
    name: kms-decryptor
  subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: deploy-runner
    namespace: ci-pipeline
  roleRef:
    kind: ClusterRole
    name: kms-decryptor
```
reverting with `kubectl delete clusterrolebinding kms-decryptor` (will follow up).

sophia: quick netpol we can apply to staging to stop egress to the KMS host (apply to default deny egress for pipeline ns):
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-egress-to-kms
  namespace: staging
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 192.168.200.10/32 # cust-kms-01
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```
apply now and also add a firewall ACL to block 192.168.200.10 from staging subnets.

jordan: found the PR — merged 2026-03-20T11:09 by @alex (infra). looks like the intent was to allow a CI tool to wrap envelopes but binding was too broad. reverting and opening small-scoped role instead.

elaine: assigning owners: raj -> RBAC rollback & token revocation, sophia -> netpol + FW ACL, jordan -> PR revert + scoped role, kevin -> key rotation plan + compliance note, i'll coordinate comms & incident ticket.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-2207 — https://ops.redwood/internal/inc/INC-2026-2207 (severity: medium, owner: elaine)

elaine: checklist for post-triage follow-up:
- [ ] confirm no prod decrypts (audit slides)
- [ ] rotate service account tokens
- [ ] rotate/rewrap key if required and document HSM audit ids
- [ ] tighten PR gates for RBAC changes (codeowners + automatic review)
- [ ] add alert: KMS.decrypt by non-admin principal -> pager
- [ ] postmortem + timeline (owner: elaine)

maria: can we add an automated reviewer that flags clusterrolebinding changes which reference kms-* roles? I can prototype an admission webhook rule.

kevin: good call — i'll author the policy and help test in staging. we should also add an automated smoke test that attempts an unauthorized decrypt and fails (run in CI).

elaine: thanks team. please update INC-2026-2207 with results as you complete tasks. will run a 30m sync in 15 mins to confirm mitigations. :white_check_mark:
